tasks.title: Implement _next_pending_wake and cap idle sleep in run_daemon (R-anchor patch)
acceptance_criteria: Single-file change to harness/autowork_daemon.py only; no other source or manifest is touched.

Adds pure helper _next_pending_wake(state_dir, config, now=None) -> float that mirrors _retry_blocked_tasks eligibility EXACTLY (exhausted skip, sidecar defaults, _DETERMINISTIC_OUTCOMES/effective_max, attempts>=effective_max skip, tiers 300/3600/86400).

Helper result == min(heartbeat, max(1.0, min(remaining over still-retryable tasks))); returns heartbeat when there are no still-retryable blocked tasks; never < 1.0 or > heartbeat; now defaults to time.time(); heartbeat from _heartbeat_interval(config).

C2 wiring: the single line 2406 'sleep_target = heartbeat if is_idle else poll' is replaced by 'sleep_target = _next_pending_wake(state_dir, config) if is_idle else poll'; everything else in run_daemon (mtime-watch 0.5s loop 2408-2415, drain, watchdog) is byte-identical.

Landed via __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ with ONE symbol patch on run_daemon (verbatim except line 2406) carrying _next_pending_wake as an R-anchor extra node inserted before run_daemon. No __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__ emitted; no whole-file rewrite.
Operator decision file state/control/decisions/daemon-wake-impl.json is present (harness/autowork_daemon.py is _NEVER_AUTO_APPROVE trust-core).
After landing, the daemon is restarted (supervisor-respawn) so the new idle-sleep cap is live.
verification_command python -m pytest tests/test_daemon_backoff_wake.py -q passes; anti-seesaw selection stays green.

spec.objective: Make submitting work sufficient for a self-pacing idle daemon: add the pure helper _next_pending_wake and cap run_daemon's idle sleep at the soonest pending timed (blocked-retry) event, so the daemon wakes exactly when a retry becomes eligible — never sooner (no hammering), never a heartbeat too late.
functional_requirements: Define _next_pending_wake(state_dir, config, now=None) -> float in harness/autowork_daemon.py as a PURE helper (no side effects); when now is None use time.time(); read heartbeat via _heartbeat_interval(config).
Scan state_dir/tasks/blocked/*.json skipping names ending '.retry.json'; if blocked/ is absent return heartbeat.
For each tid: skip if blocked/<tid>.exhausted exists; read blocked/<tid>.retry.json into {attempts,ts,last_outcome} with defaults (0, 0.0, '') on absent/corrupt, mirroring lines 914-925.

_DETERMINISTIC_OUTCOMES=('synthesis_or_ast_failed','embedded_tests_failed','narrow_fuzz_failed'); effective_max = 1 if last_outcome in _DETERMINISTIC_OUTCOMES else max_attempts (default 3); skip tasks with attempts >= effective_max.

Backoff threshold: attempts<=1 -> 300.0, attempts==2 -> 3600.0, else 86400.0; remaining = threshold - (now - ts); result = min(heartbeat, max(1.0, min(remaining over still-retryable tasks))); heartbeat when none retryable.
C2: replace ONLY line 2406 with 'sleep_target = _next_pending_wake(state_dir, config) if is_idle else poll'; keep the rest of run_daemon byte-identical.

Land via __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__: one symbol patch on run_daemon plus _next_pending_wake as an R-anchor extra node before run_daemon; no __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__, no whole-file rewrite; provide operator decision file state/control/decisions/daemon-wake-impl.json and restart the daemon (supervisor-respawn) after landing.
spec.interfaces: harness/autowork_daemon.py — new module-level pure function _next_pending_wake(state_dir: pathlib.Path, config: dict, now: float | None = None) -> float inserted before run_daemon; run_daemon's idle branch calls it. Uses already-imported time, json, pathlib and the existing _heartbeat_interval(config).
edge_cases: blocked/ missing or unreadable (OSError on glob) -> return heartbeat.
attempts already past effective_max (incl. deterministic outcome at attempts>=1) -> excluded from the min.
Large backoff (86400s) when heartbeat is 1800 -> capped to heartbeat.
Several tasks where some are excluded -> only still-retryable ones contribute to min; if all excluded -> heartbeat.
non_goals: No integration rewrite of run_daemon beyond the single line 2406; the mtime-watch loop, drain, and watchdog stay byte-identical (the word integration is named only to disclaim a cross-module integration test).
Does NOT change _retry_blocked_tasks, the backoff tiers, the heartbeat/poll config, or the mtime-watch wake — it only CAPS the idle sleep duration.
Does NOT touch any file other than harness/autowork_daemon.py; no manifest, no whole-file daemon rewrite.
Out of scope: plan-park backoff (_recently_failed_to_plan) wake-awareness and brief-resubmit auto-clean (separate follow-up briefs).
spec.implementation_notes: Emit __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ ONLY (OMIT mutation_target, OMIT __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__). The patch is a single symbol patch targeting run_daemon (autowork_daemon.py:2297-2431) reproduced VERBATIM except line 2406, which becomes 'sleep_target = _next_pending_wake(state_dir, config) if is_idle else poll'; attach _next_pending_wake as an R-anchor extra node inserted immediately before run_daemon. Mirror eligibility from _retry_blocked_tasks (883-971): exhausted skip 911-912, sidecar read+defaults 913-925, _DETERMINISTIC_OUTCOMES+effective_max 926-927, attempts>=effective_max skip 928-951, tiers 952-957. harness/autowork_daemon.py is _NEVER_AUTO_APPROVE trust-core, so write operator decision file state/control/decisions/daemon-wake-impl.json approving the land, then restart the daemon (supervisor-respawn) so the new idle-sleep cap goes live.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Reuse tests/test_daemon_backoff_wake.py from daemon-wake-oracle as the gate. Anti-seesaw: python -m pytest tests/ -k "retry_blocked or blocked_retry or backoff or daemon_idle or autowork_daemon" -q must keep all currently-green selections green. tmp_path blocked/ fixtures with retry.json sidecars and exhausted markers; config with autowork.heartbeat_sec.

token_budget_ratio.note: Small single-file R-anchor change (one new helper + one wired line); tests already authored by the oracle leaf, so test budget covers regression/anti-seesaw verification.
